title: CSCI 630 — Foundations of Artificial Intelligence
subject: Computer Vision
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of a computer vision pipeline and explain how each stage processes image data.
Explain how geometric transforms and feature methods enable coordinate mapping and pattern recognition in AI systems.
Evaluate the impact of sampling, illumination, and noise on computer vision results and identify evaluation metrics for robustness.
